propositions: Findings longer than 240 characters are silently truncated mid-token in adapter.py:122 with no ellipsis or visual marker, rendering the comment unactionable and misleading
When more than 10 blocking findings exist, the excess findings are silently dropped in adapter.py:120 with no disclosure of the omitted count, so the comment falsely claims completeness
The review-bot truncation behavior violates established codebase conventions (voter.py:440 explicitly marks truncation) and the actionable-feedback contract defined in CONTRIBUTING.md
Truncated findings must end with an explicit marker (e.g. space-ellipsis) and overflow must be disclosed (e.g. '… and N more') while preserving full machine-readable findings for downstream use
Real-world reproduction with 11 blocking findings each >240 characters confirmed the header claims 11 issues, exactly 10 bullets render, and bullets end mid-token without ellipsis or count note
